2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Dashboard and the Dashboard page is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Access as a guest starts an unauthenticated browsing session
preconditions: User not authenticated
Login page is open
steps: 1. Click the 'Access as a guest' button
test_cases.expected_result: An unauthenticated browsing session is active and a Guest session indicator is visible on the page

test_cases.test_case: Cookies notice displays cookie usage information
preconditions: User at Login page
steps: 1. Click the 'Cookies notice' button
test_cases.expected_result: Cookie usage information is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Submit with all required fields empty
preconditions: User is on the Login page
steps: 1. Leave the Username field blank
2. Leave the Password field blank
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors appear on the Username and Password fields indicating they are required; the form does not submit; user remains on the Login page; no redirect to Dashboard; Password field remains empty; Username remains empty.

test_cases.test_case: Submit with Username blank and Password filled
preconditions: User is on the Login page
steps: 1. Leave the Username field blank
2. Enter <any password> in the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Username field indicating it is required; the form does not submit; user remains on the Login page; Password field is cleared after submission; Username remains blank.

test_cases.test_case: Submit with Password blank and Username filled
preconditions: User is on the Login page
steps: 1. Enter <any username> in the Username field
2. Leave the Password field blank
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Password field indicating it is required; the form does not submit; user remains on the Login page; Password field remains empty; Username retains the entered value for correction.

test_cases.test_case: Submit with invalid credentials
preconditions: User is on the Login page
steps: 1. Enter <invalid username> in the Username field
2. Enter <invalid password> in the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: An inline error message is shown indicating authentication failure; the form does not submit and the user is not redirected to the Dashboard; the Password field is cleared; the Username field retains the entered <invalid username> for correction.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to use 'Lost password?' when feature is disabled
preconditions: User is on the Login page
Password reset feature is disabled on this test site
steps: 1. Locate the 'Lost password?' link
2. Click the 'Lost password?' link
test_cases.expected_result: 'Lost password?' link is disabled / not actionable on this site (visibly disabled or not clickable); clicking it does not navigate to a password reset page and no password reset dialog opens; no change of page occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Failed login clears password and retains username
preconditions: Login page is loaded
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
2. Enter <incorrect password> in the Password field
3. Click the "Log in" button
test_cases.expected_result: Login attempt is blocked; inline error message is shown; Password field is cleared; Username field retains the entered value for correction

test_cases.test_case: Clicking disabled 'Lost password?' link is blocked (feature disabled)
preconditions: Login page is loaded
'Lost password?' link is visible and disabled on this site
steps: 1. Focus the 'Lost password?' link
2. Click the 'Lost password?' link
test_cases.expected_result: Click is blocked; no navigation occurs and no password recovery UI appears; page remains on the Login screen and the link remains non-interactive

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click of 'Log in' with incorrect credentials
preconditions: Login page is loaded
steps: 1. Enter <username> in the Username field
2. Enter <incorrect password> in the Password field
3. Click the "Log in" button
4. Immediately click the "Log in" button a second time
test_cases.expected_result: Second submission attempt is blocked; only one inline error message is shown; Password field is cleared once; Username field retains the entered value

test_cases.test_case: Reset page to default button not available when Edit mode is Off
preconditions: Dashboard is open
Edit mode toggle is set to Off
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard page
2. Verify the Edit mode toggle is Off (do not change it)
3. Attempt to locate and click the 'Reset page to default' button at the top right
test_cases.expected_result: 'Reset page to default' button is not visible when Edit mode is Off; no reset action is performed; the dashboard layout remains unchanged and no reset confirmation or success message is shown

test_cases.test_case: Block edit controls (drag handle and context menu) are not available when Edit mode is Off
preconditions: Dashboard is open
Edit mode toggle is set to Off
Timeline and Calendar blocks are present in the main content area
steps: 1. Navigate to the Dashboard page
2. Verify the Edit mode toggle is Off (do not change it)
3. Attempt to drag the Timeline block using its drag handle
4. Attempt to open the Timeline block's three-dot context menu (Configure/Move/Delete)
test_cases.expected_result: The Timeline block's drag handle and three-dot context menu are not displayed when Edit mode is Off; no drag or context actions can be initiated and no configure/move/delete options appear

test_cases.test_case: Edit mode toggle shows and hides Edit-only controls at the visibility boundary
preconditions: User is signed in and viewing the Dashboard
Dashboard is loaded with default blocks visible
steps: 1. Click the Edit mode checkbox to turn Edit mode ON
2. Observe whether the 'Reset page to default' button is present at the top right
3. Observe whether the '+ Add a block' button is present below the Dashboard heading
4. Click the Edit mode checkbox to turn Edit mode OFF
5. Observe whether the 'Reset page to default' button is not present
6. Observe whether the '+ Add a block' button is not present
test_cases.expected_result: When Edit mode is turned ON the 'Reset page to default' and '+ Add a block' controls appear and are visible on the page (succeeds). When Edit mode is turned OFF those controls are hidden and not interactable (succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid toggle of Edit mode prevents opening Add Block page during transient state
preconditions: User is signed in and viewing the Dashboard
Dashboard is loaded
steps: 1. Rapidly click the Edit mode checkbox: ON then OFF then ON in quick succession
2. Immediately attempt to click the '+ Add a block' button (if visible) after the rapid toggles
3. Observe whether the Block_Types_Page opens
test_cases.expected_result: If Edit mode ended OFF the '+ Add a block' is not visible and any attempt to open the Block_Types_Page is blocked / error shown. If Edit mode ended ON the Block_Types_Page opens normally (succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Reorder blocks in Edit mode then use Reset page to default to restore original layout
preconditions: User is signed in and viewing the Dashboard
There are at least two blocks (Timeline and Calendar) on the Dashboard
steps: 1. Click the Edit mode checkbox to turn Edit mode ON
2. Using the Timeline block's drag handle, move the Timeline block to the position of the Calendar block
3. Observe that the blocks' positions on the page have changed
4. Click the 'Reset page to default' button
5. Observe the blocks' positions after the reset
test_cases.expected_result: After reordering, the page reflects the new block order (succeeds). Clicking 'Reset page to default' reverts the layout to the default arrangement and the Timeline and Calendar return to their original positions (succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Month navigation crosses year boundary (December → January) updates month and year heading
preconditions: User is signed in and viewing the Dashboard Calendar block
Calendar displays the current month and year in the heading
steps: 1. Click the Calendar 'Next month' button repeatedly until the month heading advances past December into January of the following year (or, if current month is December, click 'Next month' once)
2. Observe the month and year shown in the calendar heading after navigation
3. Observe whether the current date highlight is present if the current date is within the visible month
test_cases.expected_result: The calendar month and year heading increment correctly when crossing the December→January year boundary and update to the next year (succeeds). The current date highlight is shown only when the current date is within the visible month (succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Timeline search accepts a very long string containing emoji and special characters
preconditions: User is signed in and viewing the Dashboard
Timeline block is visible
steps: 1. Focus the 'Search activities' field in the Timeline block
2. Enter a very long string (200+ characters) containing a mix of special characters and emoji into the search field
3. Press Enter to perform the search
4. Observe the search results area or empty state
test_cases.expected_result: The search input accepts the long special-character/emoji string without UI failure; the search executes and either shows matching results or the Timeline's empty-state message for no matches (succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Open New Event form while viewing a far-future month in the Calendar
preconditions: User is signed in and viewing the Dashboard Calendar block
steps: 1. Click the Calendar 'Next month' button many times to navigate to a month far in the future (more than 12 months ahead)
2. Click the Calendar 'New event' button
3. Observe whether the New_Event_Form opens
test_cases.expected_result: Clicking 'New event' while viewing a far-future month opens the New_Event_Form for creating a personal calendar entry (succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to drag/reorder blocks when Edit mode is OFF is blocked
preconditions: User is signed in and viewing the Dashboard
Edit mode is OFF
steps: 1. Attempt to locate or use the Timeline block's drag handle
2. Attempt to drag the Timeline block to another position while Edit mode remains OFF
3. Observe whether the drag action changes block order
test_cases.expected_result: When Edit mode is OFF the move/drag handle is not available or not interactable and any attempt to reorder blocks is blocked / error shown (no reordering occurs).

steps: 1. Open the My Courses page

My Courses has multiple courses visible
steps: 1. Open the My Courses page

test_cases.expected_result: My Courses grid is re-ordered according to <sort option>; the visible course order reflects the selected sort

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user cannot access My Courses page
preconditions: User is signed out / not authenticated
steps: 1. From a browser, navigate to the My Courses page URL
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Login page; My Courses content (course cards, filter controls) is not displayed; no course cards are visible and access to course links is blocked.

test_cases.test_case: Click course name link does not open course when navigation fails (broken/unreachable course page)
preconditions: User is signed in as a student who is enrolled in at least one course
At least one course card is shown in the My Courses grid
steps: 1. Open the My Courses page while signed in
2. Click the Course_Name link on any course card
test_cases.expected_result: No navigation to the course main page occurs; the My Courses page remains visible; an error notification or inline message is shown indicating the course page could not be opened; the course is not opened and the user is not redirected.

test_cases.test_case: Very long / Unicode search query (>200 chars with emoji and special characters)
preconditions: User is signed in
My Courses page is loaded with multiple course cards displayed
steps: 1. Focus the Search field in the Courses_Filter_Bar
2. Enter a very long string (200+ characters) that includes Unicode characters and emoji into the Search field
3. Press Enter or click the search trigger
test_cases.expected_result: Search executes and succeeds; the UI does not crash or hang; Courses_Grid updates. If no courses match the query, the grid shows the page's 'no courses found' empty-state message and the Search field preserves the full entered string.

test_cases.test_case: Search with leading and trailing whitespace around an existing course name
preconditions: User is signed in
My Courses page is loaded and at least one course exists with a known display name
steps: 1. Focus the Search field in the Courses_Filter_Bar
2. Enter the existing course's name with leading and trailing spaces (e.g., '  <existing course name>  ')
3. Press Enter or click the search trigger
test_cases.expected_result: Search executes and succeeds; the system trims leading/trailing whitespace for matching purposes so the matching course card appears in the Courses_Grid. The Search input either displays the trimmed value or clearly shows the original input but results reflect trimmed matching (visible result: matching course card present).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click of 'Star this course' on a non-starred course
preconditions: User is signed in
My Courses page is loaded with at least one non-starred course not currently pinned at the top
steps: 1. Locate a non-starred course card in the Courses_Grid
2. Open the card's three-dot menu (if needed) to reveal 'Star this course'
3. Click 'Star this course' once
4. Within one second, click 'Star this course' again (rapid second click)
test_cases.expected_result: First click succeeds and sets the course to Starred and pins it to the top of the Courses_Grid. The immediate second click is blocked or is a no-op (no duplicate pinned entries are created); the UI shows the course only once pinned at the top and provides an inline visual state change (e.g., star control in 'starred' state or a short non-blocking toast) indicating the course is already starred. No duplicate cards or duplicate pins appear.

test_cases.test_case: Collapsed section hides its activity links (attempt to open activity inside collapsed section)
preconditions: User is authenticated as <any authorized user>
<course page> is open and at least one section contains at least one activity and is initially expanded
steps: 1. Click the chevron or 'Toggle Section Collapse' button for <section A> to collapse that section

test_cases.test_case: Collapse all hides all activity links (attempt to open activity after using 'Collapse all')

<course page> is open and contains multiple expanded sections each with activities

test_cases.test_case: Rapid repeated toggle of a section's collapse chevron
preconditions: A Course Page exists with at least one section that is currently expanded
steps: 1. Open the Course Page
2. Click the section's Toggle Section Collapse chevron
3. Immediately click the same chevron again
4. Repeat clicking the same chevron rapidly 3 more times (total 5 rapid clicks)
test_cases.expected_result: Each click toggles the chevron and the section body; after the final click the chevron direction and the section content visibility match the last click (action succeeds). No error message or persistent loading indicator is shown and the page remains responsive.

test_cases.test_case: Double-click / rapid clicks on the Collapse all link
preconditions: A Course Page exists with multiple sections currently expanded
steps: 1. Open the Course Page
2. Click the Collapse All link at the top right
3. Immediately click the Collapse All link again
test_cases.expected_result: First click collapses all sections and the page shows all sections collapsed (action succeeds). Second immediate click leaves all sections collapsed and no error is shown; the Collapse All link remains present and the UI does not create duplicate state transitions or visual glitches.

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to an activity and use browser Back to return to Course Page
preconditions: A Course Page exists with at least one activity listed in a section
steps: 1. Open the Course Page
2. Click an Activity_Link for an activity
3. On the activity/resource page, use the browser Back button
test_cases.expected_result: Clicking the Activity_Link navigates to the activity page (succeeds). Using the browser Back button returns the user to the Course Page without creating duplicate navigation entries or errors; the Course Page loads and the listing of sections and activities is visible. The page does not crash and navigation returns to the course context (action succeeds).

test_cases.test_case: Display of very long section titles and titles containing emoji/special characters

steps: 1. Open the Course Page
2. Locate the section with the very long / unicode-containing title

The section title is readable (wraps or truncates with a visible indicator such as ellipsis) and the chevron remains clickable; no replacement glyphs or rendering errors are shown.

test_cases.test_case: Non-owner is blocked when attempting to submit Update profile even if form is reachable
preconditions: <logged-in as a user who is not the profile owner>
steps: 1. Log in as <logged-in as a user who is not the profile owner>
2. If the Edit profile link is visible, click it to open the Profile_Form (simulating a UI bug that exposes the form)
3. Change a non-privileged field (e.g., enter <new description> into Description)
4. Click the 'Update profile' button
test_cases.expected_result: On submit, an authorization/permission error is displayed and the update is blocked; the Profile_Form remains open or returns to a non-editable view without applying changes; the target profile is not modified.

test_cases.test_case: Very long Description (>200 characters) in General panel
preconditions: User is profile owner
Profile page is open
steps: 1. Click the 'Edit profile' link
2. If the 'General' panel is collapsed, click to expand the 'General' panel
3. Focus the 'Description' field
4. Enter a very long string (>200 characters) into the 'Description' field
5. Click the 'Update profile' button
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission succeeds; the profile is saved and the edit form closes. On the Profile page the 'Description' area displays the full entered text (no truncation visible in the UI).

test_cases.test_case: Names containing special Unicode characters and emoji
preconditions: User is profile owner
Profile page is open
steps: 1. Click the 'Edit profile' link
2. If the 'General' panel is collapsed, click to expand the 'General' panel
3. Enter a string containing emoji and non-ASCII Unicode characters into the 'First name' field
4. Enter a string containing emoji and non-ASCII Unicode characters into the 'Last name' field
5. Click the 'Update profile' button
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission succeeds; the profile is saved and the edit form closes. On the Profile page the displayed First and Last name show the entered emoji and Unicode characters exactly (visible characters match what was entered).

test_cases.test_case: Leading and trailing whitespace in First name is trimmed on save
preconditions: User is profile owner
Profile page is open
steps: 1. Click the 'Edit profile' link
2. If the 'General' panel is collapsed, click to expand the 'General' panel
3. Enter a value with leading and trailing whitespace into the 'First name' field
4. Click the 'Update profile' button
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission succeeds; the profile is saved and the edit form closes. On the Profile page the displayed First name has leading and trailing whitespace trimmed (no visible leading/trailing spaces).

test_cases.test_case: Clicking Log out redirects to Login page
preconditions: User logged in as <User>
steps: 1. Ensure the application main/header is visible
2. Click the 'Log out' button
test_cases.expected_result: The Login page is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Logout control not available to unauthenticated user / direct logout URL redirects
preconditions: User is not logged in
steps: 1. Open the application in a fresh browser session (no authentication cookies)
2. Navigate to the page/area where the 'Log out' control normally appears
3. In the browser address bar, enter the logout endpoint URL (e.g. /logout) and press Enter
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Log out' button is not visible on the page. Direct navigation to the logout endpoint redirects to the Login page; no authenticated session is established. Protected UI and data are not accessible.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to use 'Log out' after session already terminated (stale session)
preconditions: User is logged in in at least one browser tab
steps: 1. In Tab A, log in as a valid user and navigate to a page showing the 'Log out' button
2. In Tab B (same browser or another browser), perform 'Log out' to terminate the session
3. Back in Tab A, click the 'Log out' button
test_cases.expected_result: Click is blocked from performing a second valid logout: Tab A is redirected to the Login page (no authenticated session restored) and no protected content is shown. No server-side error page is displayed; the user remains unauthenticated.

test_cases.test_case: Protected pages remain inaccessible after performing Log out
preconditions: User is logged in
steps: 1. Log in as a valid user
2. Click the 'Log out' button to terminate the session
3. After logout completes, attempt to navigate to a known protected page (e.g. dashboard or account page)
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation to the protected page is blocked: the browser is redirected to the Login page and protected content is not displayed. The UI requires re-authentication to access the protected page.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click of Log out button
preconditions: User is logged in and Log out button is visible
steps: 1. Sign in with valid credentials
2. Navigate to a protected page where the 'Log out' button is visible
3. Rapidly click the 'Log out' button twice within one second
test_cases.expected_result: First logout click succeeds: the user is redirected to the login page and the authenticated session is terminated (login form visible). The second click is ignored (no additional redirects or errors shown) and protected pages require re-authentication.

test_cases.test_case: Logout in one tab then attempt protected action in another tab
preconditions: User is logged in in two separate browser tabs
A protected page is open in Tab B
steps: 1. In Tab A, sign in with valid credentials
2. In Tab B, open a protected page URL and confirm protected content is visible
3. In Tab A, click the 'Log out' button
4. In Tab B, attempt a protected action (e.g., click a button that requires authentication) or press the browser Refresh button on the protected page
test_cases.expected_result: Logout in Tab A succeeds: Tab A redirects to the login page and the session is terminated. The action in Tab B is blocked; Tab B displays the login page (or an inline re-authentication prompt) and protected content/actions are not accessible (access is blocked).

test_cases.test_case: Browser Back after logout should not restore protected content
preconditions: User is logged in and on a protected page where the 'Log out' button is visible
steps: 1. Sign in with valid credentials
2. Navigate to a protected page
3. Click the 'Log out' button
4. On the login page, press the browser Back button once
test_cases.expected_result: Logout succeeds: the user is redirected to the login page and the session is terminated. Back navigation is blocked from restoring authenticated access: the application shows the login page and prompts for credentials; protected content is not accessible (access is blocked).

test_cases.test_case: Attempt direct navigation to a protected URL after logout
preconditions: User is logged in and a protected page URL is known
steps: 1. Sign in with valid credentials
2. Click the 'Log out' button
3. In the same browser tab, enter a protected page URL into the address bar and press Enter
test_cases.expected_result: Logout succeeds: the user is redirected to the login page and the session is terminated. Direct navigation to the protected URL is blocked; the app displays the login page and requires re-authentication (access is blocked).
